description: Calculate Washington State Real Estate Excise Tax (REET, RCW 82.45) for one sale: graduated state brackets plus the county's local rate, computed deterministically by SENTINEL's production engine — never estimated. Use when you need the exact excise tax owed on a WA home sale (seller-paid by default). Washington State counties only. The result includes the per-bracket breakdown, the $5 DOR technology fee, and rate-assumption caveats (verify the DOR location code for city-level exceptions). Uses no third-party data. The result includes an 'attributions' array (upstream source lines and the NWMLS/DOR/county non-affiliation line) and a professional-advice disclaimer — pass both through to end users.
